theorems.name: Submission.idod_local_uniform_ball_mass_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (K'' : Set (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (Λ σ₀ θ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ), 0 ≤ Λ → 0 < σ₀ → θ < θ₁ → θ₁ < θ₂ → HasMassDensity T y θ → closedBall y (2 * σ₀) ⊆ K'' → (∀ (z : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), closedBall z R ⊆ K'' → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball z ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y' ∈ ball y δ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → T.massOn (ball y' ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ₂ * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
